card.name: Just before a famous politician's name
card.fires_on: Linking words or punctuation right before the name of a well-known public figure, mostly US presidents or world leaders, in general web text such as quizzes, biographies and news.

modes.label: Quiz list options
modes.description: The period after an option letter in a list of presidents, just before the next name.
modes.example: c. Millard Fillmore d<<.>> Abraham Lincoln 1. “The King

modes.label: Biography or title phrases
modes.description: Words like of, as, and or a dash that lead into a famous person's name.
modes.example: Biography<< of>> former United States President George Herbert Walker Bush

modes.label: Lists of famous people
modes.description: Words introducing examples of celebrities or leaders.
modes.example: well-known Americans such<< as>> Martha Stewart, Yo Yo Ma, Norman

card.writes: It favors first names of political figures like Mitt, Barack, Vladimir and Mikhail, and suppresses surnames such as Bush, Clinton and Trump.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name a famous president or leader, and pushes toward a first name.
